The queens are stepping aside — it's time for the KINGS to take over 👑🔥

Eight kings. One stage. Zero chill. Cherry Pop is hosting her very first show and bringing out the whole squad to prove it: Phish Tako, Puddlezz, Jen Durless, Edward Demizer, Dominic Trix, Beah Hazard, Dick Van Dykeotomy, and Sr Night Haven Rexia. Debuts, comebacks, and legends all sharing one floor.

Heartbreaker energy. Magnetic presence. The kind of swagger that makes you forget to breathe.

This is the lineup you screenshot for the group chat. Get in before it sells out.

📅 Sunday, July 26 — Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$20
🔞 21+

The lights dim. The bass drops. And suddenly the room belongs to the kings 🖤

Picture it — smoke curling under red light, Cherry Pop's voice cutting through the crowd for her hosting debut, and eight kings serving charisma, heartthrob energy, and pure swagger one number at a time. The tips fly. The floor doesn't stop moving until the last lip sync hits.

This isn't just a show, it's a full sensory takeover. Feel the bass in your chest. Feel the energy in the room. Feel yourself losing your voice cheering for your favorite king.

Sunday nights were made for this.
